race.title: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
race.verdict: Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with the lightly-raced KING HORSE taking a sizeable step forward now with Nicky Richards and capitalising on a lenient-looking mark. Tigress Lilly arrives in top form and rates a big danger though, while handicap debutant Old Comrades can also play a prominent role. KING HORSE (FR) TIGRESS LILLY OLD COMRADES (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Tigress Lilly (5/2), Les's Legacy (6/1), Old Comrades (7/1), Zephlyn (8/1), Poetry Man (8/1), King Horse (8/1), Dusky Days (10/1), Evenwood Sonofagun (12/1), Asa (14/1), Dartmouth Star (16/1), On The Bubble (20/1)
